title: Participation (PNL)
subtitle: PNL is a fixed-supply token used as a coordination and participation mechanism within PonyLife — not as an investment product.

sections.heading: What PNL is
sections.body: A participation unit used to align voluntary actions and coordinate access within the ecosystem.

sections.heading: What PNL is not
sections.body: Not equity. Not a security. Not a promise of profit. No guaranteed utility, value, or outcome.

sections.heading: Technical facts
sections.body: Network: Base. Supply: fixed. Contract: publicly verified. Liquidity exists at experimental levels.

sections.heading: Risk & uncertainty
sections.body: Participation involves uncertainty. PonyLife does not provide financial guarantees, and outcomes cannot be predicted.
